Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

CHILDREN’S ART AND CRAFT WORKSHOPS

Adults must accompany children under
Cost: £2.50
Workshops held in: Winter House, Street

transcript.en: Good morning, Synmouth Museum.
Can I help you?
Oh yes.
Good morning.
I'm interested in the children's workshops and I'd like a little more information, please.
transcript.zh: 我对儿童学习班感兴趣，我想多了解一些信息。

transcript.en: Do you mean the Art and Craft workshops?
transcript.zh: 你是指艺术手工学习班吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
A friend of a friend mentioned them - the children do painting and make models and so forth.
transcript.zh: 朋友的朋友提过那里，孩子们可以作画或者做模型等等。

transcript.en: Yes, of course.
Um, where to begin?
First of all, as you probably know, they run every Saturday.
transcript.zh: 首先，你可能知道他们每周六开课。

transcript.en: Fine.
And what about ages?
Well, all ages from five upwards are welcome, though we do ask that children below eight years of age are accompanied by an adult.
transcript.zh: 欢迎所有5岁以上的人。但是我们要求8岁以下的儿童有大人的陪伴。

transcript.en: Fine.
That wouldn't be a problem.
What about cost?
Well, I think you'll find them very reasonable.
transcript.zh: 我想你会觉得价格很合理。

transcript.en: It's ￡2.50 a child, with 80 pence off for two or more children from the same family.
transcript.zh: 一个孩子2.50英镑，来自同一家庭的两个或两个以上孩子减去80便士。

transcript.en: Oh yes, very reasonable.
And are they held in the main museum?
transcript.zh: 是的，非常合理。这些都是在博物馆里举办吗？

transcript.en: Not exactly.
They're nearby.
Could you give me the full address?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我详细的地址吗？

transcript.en: I don't know the area very well.
transcript.zh: 我对那个地方不是很熟。

transcript.en: Yes, it's Winter House.
Right.
And that's in Tamer Street.
Could you spell that please?
Yes, T-A-M-E-R Street.
Lovely.
And I do need to tell you that there's a security entrance, so you need to press the green button for someone to let you in.
transcript.zh: 我得告诉你，那里有安检入口。所以你得按动绿色按钮才有人放你进来。

transcript.en: Don't press the red button please, but don't worry, it's all clearly labelled.
transcript.zh: 请不要按动红色按钮，不过别担心，都清楚地写明了。

transcript.en: OK.
And one more question - is parking available nearby?
transcript.zh: 还有一个问题。附近能停车吗？

transcript.en: We're driving in from out of town.
Your best bet is to leave your car at the back of the library - on a Saturday morning there are plenty of spaces there.
transcript.zh: 你最好把车停在图书馆后面。周六早上那里有很多停车位，

transcript.en: It's right next door to the museum.
And can I ask about booking places?
Yes, and I must tell you, you really should book by calling the education department here.
transcript.zh: 是的，我必须告诉你，你应该打给这里的教育部进行预约。

transcript.en: Oh, I'm sorry, should I have rung them instead of the main museum number?
transcript.zh: 对不起。我应该给他们打电话而不是给博物馆吗？

transcript.en: No, that's fine this time, please don't worry.
But for future reference, I'll give you the direct number.
transcript.zh: 但是为了以备后用，我给你他们的直线号码。

transcript.en: It's two hundred—seven—six—five.
Great, I've got that.
But I'm very happy to give you information about the next two workshops.
transcript.zh: 但是我很高兴给你介绍接下来的两个学习班。

transcript.en: On Saturday the 16th there's Building Castles.
transcript.zh: 周六也就是16日有一个城堡的建设。

transcript.en: Oh, sounds great!
This involves quite a bit of glue, so just make sure the kids are in old clothes.
transcript.zh: 这需要用到很多胶水，所以让孩子穿旧衣服来。

transcript.en: I know, ones I don't mind getting mucky.
transcript.zh: 我知道。挑一件我不介意弄脏的。

transcript.en: Exactly.
And if possible, could you bring along bottle tops which the children might be able to use in the models, you know, as decoration?
transcript.zh: 如果可以的话，你可以带点瓶子盖来，给孩子们在模型上做装饰用吗？

transcript.en: We'll certainly try to find some for you.
transcript.zh: 我肯定会试着为你们找一些。

transcript.en: Then the following week...
That'll be the 23rd, won't it?
Yes, that's right.
On that day, it's what we call Undersea Worlds.
transcript.zh: 在那天我们称之为海底世界。

transcript.en: This is where they make scenes with fishes, underground caverns and so on.
transcript.zh: 他们会在那里制作一些有鱼和地下洞穴之类的场景。

transcript.en: Is that likely to get very dirty?
Lots of paint splashes?
Not really, so we don't recommend any special clothes for that one.
transcript.zh: 不会，我们不推荐在那天穿一些特别的服装。

transcript.en: But if you could search out some silver paper to bring along to use in the sessions, you know, it's shiny, it looks like water, that'd be great.
transcript.zh: 但是如果你可以找来一些锡纸用在这节课上就更好了，它会很闪亮，像水一样。

transcript.en: Yes, of course.
We'll see what we can come up with.
Well, thank you ever so much for all your help.
The sessions sound really good and I'll certainly book up for the next two.
transcript.zh: 课程听起来很棒，我肯定会预约下两节。

transcript.en: Lovely.
Thanks very much for ringing.
Bye.
Bye bye.
